blocks.text_en: The E2E_P02Check() function shall reset the NoNewOrRepeatedDataCounter to 0 if it returns one of the following status: • E2E_P02ST A TUS_OK; or • E2E_P02ST A TUS_OKSOMELOST; or • E2E_P02ST A TUS_SYNC; or • E2E_P02ST A TUS_WRONGSEQUENCE
